sources.scope: Enclosure-side oblique: flared tub, three visible red strip groups, external orange case, blue front-corner hardware and low metal strip.
Yellow-handle end: tub width, molded end recess, yellow attachment, two white lights, blue side hardware, black bumper and red detail.
Opposite-side oblique: tapered tub and floor ribs, longer rear overhang, strip lights and low silver strip.
Raised tub exposes gray rectangular frame, silver longitudinal members, crosspiece, fasteners, ties and chassis.
Indoor assembled front view confirms component relationships without bucket.
Low front view reveals tub brackets/bolt heads, thin transverse member, purple-marked tube ends, light-colored spacer, shocks/guards and red axle-center housing.
Outdoor view appears to repeat the CAD-P03 scene at different resolution/crop. Not counted as an independent build/test.
